skill.summary: Automatically notifies when the gateway restarts by detecting a recovery flag and sending an "I'm back!" message during heartbeat checks.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Gateway Recovery Notification Skill.
- Automatically detects gateway restarts and creates a recovery flag.
- Sends an "I'm back!" notification upon recovery detection.
- Clears the recovery flag after notification.
- Configuration and testing instructions included in documentation.
